technical.summary: Bullish momentum structure with price above all key moving averages and positive stochastic cross, but momentum oscillators (MACD, PPO) remain bearish, creating a mixed technical picture suitable for cautious entry on pullback confirmation.

fundamental.summary: LMT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 54 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (21/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction (small purchases by junior members, one sale) and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (382.8) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 54 days adds moderate event risk; macro score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with bullish supertrend and stochastic cross provides technical structure for entry, especially in extreme fear regime (21/100) offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: VIX crisis regime (382.8), unfavorable macro (-1), MACD/PPO bearish momentum divergence, zero fundamental conviction, and earnings risk in 54 days create a hostile environment that outweighs technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows price above moving averages with bullish supertrend, but this is insufficient to justify entry given VIX crisis regime (382.8), bearish momentum divergence (MACD/PPO), and zero fundamental conviction in a hostile macro environment.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis conditions (382.8) combined with unfavorable macro (-1) and earnings event risk in 54 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical structure.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding LMT with 46 existing Industrials positions (33% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing position reduce conviction further; skip new entry.
